summary: Greenland Mines Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 1,320,000 common shares at $13.00 per share, or roughly $17.2 million gross, under a September 28, 2026 securities purchase agreement with certain investors. The September 25, 2026 last sale was $14.66, implying about an 11% discount. No placement agent was retained; pricing was negotiated directly. The offering terminates September 30, 2026, with settlement expected on or about that date via DTC. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and any follow-on pricing pressure.
